task: Implement the M0-M1 slice of the Proof-or-Stop agent-drivability roadmap and the minimal #6 scope-plan dispatch unblocker so INIT and PLAN guidance route agents to the right preflight/reviewer commands.
outcome: After this story, when a user creates or resumes an INIT story and runs lattice session_brief, lattice next, lattice --help, hits an INIT_CHECK gate failure, or needs PLAN scope review, the terminal output clearly routes them to lattice init_preflight or a story-level lattice-review-scope-plan dispatch path and does not imply that evidence gates were skipped.
facts: The confirmed failure mode is discoverability/routing, not weak gate semantics.
init_preflight already exists and aggregates INIT_CHECK prerequisites read-only.
Current session_brief/next and global help still route directly to story_advance INIT_CHECK.
Current lattice dispatch rejects story-level lattice-review-scope-plan without itemId, which is the documented #6 blocker.
This story now includes the minimal #6 dispatch unblocker because PLAN review cannot progress without scope-plan reviewer evidence.
constraints: Do not weaken dual INIT reviewer, scope anti-expansion, verificationIntent, review, TEST, DONE, or production-readiness gates.
Do not auto-run commands or write evidence from init_preflight/session_brief/help surfaces.
Do not let the main implementation agent self-sign scope_check_save.
Keep changes scoped to INIT routing plus minimal story-level scope-plan dispatch.
Story operations must go through lattice commands, not direct JSON edits.
Remote publish is out of scope.
unknowns: Which existing focused test file is the smallest stable home for M1 routing assertions.
Whether the M0 baseline contract should live only in the decision doc or also in a small machine-readable test fixture.
Whether existing dispatch tests already cover story-level INIT reviewers and item-scoped reviewers enough to extend safely.
